proposed.explanation: The controlling source is PD 1096 Rule V. Sections 501 to 507 define fire zones, the more-than-one-third rule for buildings in multiple zones, moved/pre-engineered buildings, temporary buildings, center-line measurement, restrictions on existing nonconforming buildings, and LGU designation of fire zones.
